verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
NEEWAAYO mu mikono
Gya Yesu kaakano;
Essanyu lyo linkutte,
Sirema kwewaayo.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Omwana wa Katonda,
Yesu anjagala;
Neewaayo gy'oli wekka,
N'ebyange-era byonna.

verse.name: v3
v4
verse.lines:
Kabaka wange-ontwale
Ne bye nnina byonna;
Onkuume n'ekisa kyo,
Mbeerenga mwesigwa.
